title: PullRequest
description: A pull/merge request pulled from the connector API.

open_threads.description: Unresolved review conversations; null when the pull request is not open or the provider cannot say.

draft.description: Marked as not ready for review; null when the provider does not say. Added to v1 as an optional field.

requested_reviewers.description: Logins still owing a review. Absent on nodes written before the field existed.

requested_teams.description: Teams still owing a review, by name.

reviews.description: Each reviewer's last word on an open pull request; null when it is not open or the reviews could not be read.

review_decision.description: What the reviews amount to, derived by Studio (pull_request_waits.rs); null with no reviews read or nothing asked.
